# Easy Footings

> Easy Footings is Melbourne and Victoria's specialist installer of concrete-free footing systems from BMSA Footing Solutions. We install RapidStump, StumpRite and SurePile mechanical footing systems that let builders, owner-builders and homeowners begin construction immediately with no concrete, no curing time, and no weather delays.

Key facts about the business:

- Trading name: Easy Footings
- Legal entity: Easy Footings Pty Ltd
- ABN: 44 689 644 175
- Phone: 0419 994 555 (Australia: +61 419 994 555)
- Contact form: https://easyfootings.com.au/#contact
- Website: https://easyfootings.com.au
- Service area: Melbourne metropolitan area and regional Victoria, Australia (Geelong, Ballarat, Bendigo, Mornington Peninsula, Gippsland, Yarra Ranges, Sunbury, Macedon)
- Products installed: RapidStump, StumpRite, SurePile (manufactured by BMSA Footing Solutions)
- Applications: new home stumps, house restumping, deck and pergola footings, sheds, granny flats, extensions, modular and prefabricated buildings, retaining walls, fences, signs, solar panel arrays
- Key benefits: install in any weather, build immediately, engineer certified to Australian standards, lower carbon footprint than concrete, removable and reusable, adjustable

## Core pages

- [Home](https://easyfootings.com.au/): Overview of Easy Footings, products, service areas, process and contact details.
- [Blog index](https://easyfootings.com.au/blog/): Articles and guides on concrete-free footings, regulations, and product comparisons.

## Products

- [RapidStump](https://easyfootings.com.au/products/rapidstump.html): Concrete-free stumps and steel footings - a hybrid all-in-one driven steel footing and stump for residential and light-commercial construction. Used as a Surefoot alternative for stumped builds and house restumping.
- [StumpRite](https://easyfootings.com.au/products/stumprite.html): Adjustable steel stumps and adjustable footings, Australian-made, with up to 120 mm of screw height adjustment. Full ecosystem of tops, plates, bases and bracing for new builds and restumping.
- [SurePile](https://easyfootings.com.au/products/surepile.html): Heavy-duty helical screw pile footings and cyclone-rated steel anchor footings for high loads, reactive clay, sloping blocks, modular and container buildings.

Easy Footings positions these three systems as a fully engineered concrete-free alternative to Surefoot and to traditional concrete piers across Melbourne and Victoria.

## Guides and articles

- [Shed Footings in Victoria](https://easyfootings.com.au/blog/shed-footings-victoria.html): Victorian guide to shed and garage footings, covering why wind uplift (not dead load) governs the design, kit shed engineering and column reactions, slab vs pad footing vs concrete-free screw pile options, Class 10a building and planning permit thresholds, holding-down connections, reactive clay and sloping or remote farm sites, and indicative 2026 installed costs for garden sheds, garages, farm and machinery sheds and American barns.
- [Tiny House Footings in Victoria](https://easyfootings.com.au/blog/tiny-house-footings-victoria.html): Victorian guide to tiny house footings, covering the legal distinction between a tiny house on wheels (THOW, movable dwelling) and a tiny house on foundations (THOF, Class 1a building), per-support load design, screw piles on sloping and off-grid regional blocks, BAL-rated sites, and indicative 2026 installed costs.
- [Shipping Container Home Footings in Victoria](https://easyfootings.com.au/blog/shipping-container-home-footings-victoria.html): Victorian guide to shipping container home footings, covering why containers are a corner-casting point-load problem rather than a slab problem, Class 1a permits, BAL and bushfire sites, screw piles under corner castings on sloping and remote regional blocks, transportable and off-grid container cabins, and indicative 2026 installed costs for one to four container builds.
- [Concrete Footings in Australia: The Complete 2026 Guide](https://easyfootings.com.au/blog/concrete-footings-australia.html): National pillar article covering concrete footing types (strip, pad, raft, bored pier, mass, concrete stumps), AS 2870 soil classes A through P, typical depths, 2026 indicative costs per linear metre and per pier, state-by-state notes for NSW, VIC, QLD, SA, WA, TAS, ACT and NT, common failure modes and when engineered concrete-free footings outperform traditional concrete.
- [Surefoot vs Easy Footings (RapidStump, StumpRite, SurePile)](https://easyfootings.com.au/blog/surefoot-vs-easy-footings.html): Independent 2026 comparison of Surefoot and the BMSA concrete-free footing range supplied by Easy Footings, covering geometry, load capacity, soil suitability, install method, certification and cost. Useful when builders are searching for a Surefoot alternative in Australia.
- [Concrete-Free Footings vs Traditional Concrete](https://easyfootings.com.au/blog/concrete-free-footings-vs-traditional-concrete.html): Side-by-side comparison of cost, speed, durability and environmental impact.
- [Building Footing Regulations in Victoria](https://easyfootings.com.au/blog/building-footing-regulations-victoria.html): Overview of the relevant Victorian building codes and engineering certification requirements.
- [Deck Footing Installation Guide (Victoria)](https://easyfootings.com.au/blog/deck-footing-installation-guide-victoria.html): Step-by-step guide to selecting and installing footings for decks in Victoria.
- [Pergola Footings in Melbourne](https://easyfootings.com.au/blog/pergola-footings-melbourne.html): Wind-uplift design, building permits, post-anchor detail and concrete-free pile options for pergolas, alfresco extensions and louvred-roof patios across Melbourne and Victoria.
- [Granny Flat Footings in Victoria](https://easyfootings.com.au/blog/granny-flat-footings-victoria.html): Slab vs piers vs screw piles for granny flats and secondary dwellings under Victoria's 2026 planning rules, covering costs, soil classes, access constraints and building permit requirements.
- [Backyard Office Pod Footings in Melbourne](https://easyfootings.com.au/blog/backyard-office-pod-footings-melbourne.html): Foundations for backyard office pods, studios and prefab work-from-home cabins, covering permits, soil, the modular drop-in install workflow and indicative pile footing costs in Melbourne backyards.
- [Footings for Sloping Blocks in Melbourne](https://easyfootings.com.au/blog/footings-sloping-blocks-melbourne.html): Why concrete-free screw piles beat bored piers on sloping and hillside Victorian blocks, covering soil, council rules, costs and practical install tips for Melbourne builders.
- [Footings Near Trees in Melbourne](https://easyfootings.com.au/blog/footings-near-trees-melbourne.html): How to manage footing design near established trees and protected root zones.
- [House Restumping Melbourne Guide](https://easyfootings.com.au/blog/house-restumping-melbourne-guide.html): When and how to restump a house in Melbourne, signs of stump failure and process.
- [Screw Pile Footings: Melbourne Guide](https://easyfootings.com.au/blog/screw-pile-footings-guide-melbourne.html): Complete introduction to screw pile footings for Melbourne builders.
- [RapidStump vs StumpRite vs SurePile](https://easyfootings.com.au/blog/rapidstump-vs-stumprite-vs-surepile.html): Detailed comparison of the three product lines and their typical use cases.
